Subject: SecEng headcount + comp band alignment for Q3 hiring plan

Team —

Quick note to align on headcount and comp bands for the SecEng (GRC + SecOps) hires we want to kick off in Q3. Summary:

- Requesting 4 net new roles: 2 GRC engineers (mid-senior), 1 SecOps engineer (senior), 1 Manager, Security Operations (manager).
- Hiring start target: early August; need offers ready by 7/15 to hit ramp.
- Budget owner: Product org has greenlit HC but we need comp bands signed off by People + Finance.

Attached: seceng_compbands_q3.xlsx (draft bands) and headcount_rationale_q3.pdf (business justification).

Ask: please review bands and confirm if we can proceed with the proposed ranges. If approved, I'll route to Finance for allocation and cc Recruiting to start tabletop with TalentHire.

Notes on bands (high level):
- GRC Eng (IC3): $160k–$190k base + typical equity banding
- GRC Eng (IC4): $190k–$220k
- SecOps (IC4/Senior): $200k–$240k
- SecOps Manager (M1): $220k–$260k

Mina — can you confirm these align with recent offers and whether we should add an override for location adjustments?
Marcus — would like your sign-off on manager band and whether we should recruit externally for manager role.
Evelyn — if you want to fold this into the Q3 HC packet for Exec review, any timing constraints?

Thanks,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Security Engineering (SecEng)
Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112


From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, Amy Patel <amy@talenthire.co>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SecEng headcount + comp band alignment for Q3 hiring plan

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick thoughts after reviewing the attachment: I think the ranges look reasonable overall but propose small adjustments to mitigate market pressure in SF/SEA offices:

- IC3 (GRC mid-senior): $165k–$195k (raise floor by 5k)
- IC4 (GRC): $195k–$225k (raise cap by 5k)
- SecOps senior: keep $200k–$240k but add £/€ localization note for EU hires
- Manager (M1): $230k–$270k (increase by 10k at top end to be competitive)

Also recommend a short candidate funnel commitment: 4-6 viable screens per role before offer. If Recruiting confirms the funnel, People can pre-authorize a limited sign-on budget per role (up to $25k for manager, $10k for IC4).

I've attached a short comparison sheet I ran against offers in last 90 days (see seceng_compbands_q3.xlsx, tab 'market').

Mina
Sr. Total Rewards Partner
--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Thanks — quick confirmation from my side: manager band looks fine; prefer we hire external for the Manager role given the leadership experience required. For the IC roles, we can consider internal uplift for one of the GRC positions if we have a strong internal candidate.

One item: can we get Finance to pre-allocate the HC budget chunk and mark these positions as 'exec review pending' so Recruiting can begin outreach? If Folks have no objections I'll ask Recruiting to open reqs next week.

Marcus
